meta.title: Institutional Digital Gateway — Conceptual Public Portal
meta.description: Conceptual demo: religious services, news, prayer times, Quran, hadith, fatwa and 81 provincial offices in one gateway. Not an official government site.

demo.banner: Conceptual demo / portfolio project. Not an official Diyanet website. Use official sources for worship.

prayer.title: Prayer times
prayer.disclaimer: Times come from an external calculation service. Confirm before worship.
prayer.disclaimerAladhan: Times are calculated via Aladhan using Diyanet method 13. This is not the official Diyanet app; confirm before worship.
prayer.disclaimerFallback: The external timetable service could not be reached. An approximate solar formula was used. Use an official source for worship.
prayer.disclaimerLocal: Times were read from a local table. Use an official source for worship.

pages.newsLead: Institutional notices and news are published via the API. Texts are editorial content of this conceptual portal.
pages.quranLead: Arabic text and Diyanet Turkish translation. Audio source: everyayah.com (Alafasy).
pages.hadithLead: The daily hadith comes from the local archive; Bukhari sections are fetched from an external API.
pages.fatwaLead: Educational catechism summaries. Not a binding fatwa or official ruling.
pages.sermonsLead: Friday sermon archive. Texts belong to the portal editors; this is not an official sermon feed.
pages.publicationsLead: Books, magazines and research cards. If there is no file, only a text preview is offered.
pages.eventsLead: Upcoming and past programmes in the portal calendar.
pages.provincesLead: 81 provinces. Addresses and phones are not invented; prayer times are live for the selected province.
pages.prayerLead: Select a province and district for daily times and the monthly table. Source: Aladhan, Diyanet calculation method (13).
pages.hajjLead: This page is not an official application gateway. Guide content comes from the API.
pages.mediaLead: Broadcast cards. If there is no video file the player shows an empty state; fake stream URLs are not used.
pages.searchLead: Search news, sermons, publications, hadith, fatwa and events.
pages.imageSourcesLead: Photos are downloaded from Wikimedia Commons and stored locally as WebP. The Diyanet logo is not copied.
pages.servicesLead: A single directory from prayer times to applications.
pages.religiousDaysLead: Hijri dates use Aladhan conversion. They may differ by a day from the official calendar.
pages.religiousLead: Quran, hadith, fatwa, sermons and publications on one platform via live APIs.
pages.findMosqueLead: This portal has no coordinated mosque dataset. You are directed to the provincial office directory.
pages.notFoundLead: The content you are looking for may have moved or never existed.
